selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline topology/interfaces discovered on all nodes
selected_evidence.summary: Showed node1 (VyOS) and node2 (Alpine) share eth0 on 10.100.22.0/24 with node3, and both have an unconfigured second NIC (eth1) for the private link.

selected_evidence.requirement: Private subnet configured between node1 and node2, isolated from node3
selected_evidence.summary: Assigned 10.50.50.254/24 on node1 eth1 and 10.50.50.11/24 on node2 eth1 via VyOS commit/save and Alpine ifup; confirmed ping between them works.

selected_evidence.requirement: Application listening on node2 port 8080, bound to private link only
selected_evidence.summary: Created persistent OpenRC 'demoapp' socat service bound to 10.50.50.11:8080; confirmed listening and returning HTTP content when queried from node1.

selected_evidence.requirement: VyOS DNAT + scoped firewall publishing port 8080 through node1
selected_evidence.summary: Configured nat destination rule 10 (eth0:8080 -> 10.50.50.11:8080) and forward filter default-drop with rule 5 (established/related) and rule 10 scoped to protocol tcp / destination 10.50.50.11:8080; committed and saved; show output confirms config.

selected_evidence.requirement: Fixed asymmetric routing so forwarded connections actually complete
selected_evidence.summary: conntrack showed UNREPLIED SYN due to node2 replying via eth0 instead of eth1; added host route 10.100.22.12/32 via 10.50.50.254 dev eth1 on node2, after which curl from node3 succeeded (HTTP 200).

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 can reach app on port 8080 via node1, but not the rest of the private network
selected_evidence.summary: curl to node1:8080 returns app content; nc to 10.50.50.11:8080, 10.50.50.254:22, and node1:9090 all time out/refuse from node3.

selected_evidence.requirement: Route persisted across reboot in Alpine network config
selected_evidence.summary: Added 'up ip route add 10.100.22.12/32 via 10.50.50.254 dev eth1' to /etc/network/interfaces eth1 stanza on node2.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 5bcff8f9...; reboot issued; new boot_id a82440c4... with uptime 0m; post-restart NAT/firewall config intact and node3->node1:8080 curl succeeded.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id b5a3412a...; reboot issued; new boot_id 0f70d492... with uptime 0m; post-restart private IP, return route, and demoapp service all restored, end-to-end curl succeeded.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
